scope: Independent full native admin Settings persistence acceptance for EXT-D-0084 and EXT-D-0086

source_review.admin_reset_oracle: Accepts the matrx.user.isAdmin overlap only when the post-reset value is exactly false. After reload, separately asserts guest UI with visible Sign in, no access token, no profile, and no true admin gate. A retained true gate remains unexplained and fails.

guard_proof_review.findings: The proof runner has three fixed, named D84/D86 fault cases and invokes the sanctioned forcing-function plant.py with an explicit expected-red assertion. The report records 21/21 green before and after restoration, a causal red for each planted fault, and SHA-256 restoration checks for production SettingsView.tsx after each case and at exit. The resource policy adds one exact runner allowlist entry. No broad test selection or production source change was introduced.
guard_proof_review.limits: This source audit relies on the committed proof report and source diff; the proof suite was not rerun in this lane.
